expectation: The selected utility model may prefer $3.49/environment/online for purchase share. I expect lower-price demand gains not to imply the best profit: rankings may change with hypothetical costs, model family or training fold. Evaluate all observed price/message/channel levels on 200 build households, fixed competitor offers, and no counterfactual history. Compare fold fits and model families. Do not infer causal effects, real profit, channel superiority, or claim efficacy. No check outcomes will be accessed.

inputs.decision_rule: Report a model-favored test candidate only if the selected utility family and at least 4/5 fold fits agree on the purchase-share winner. Otherwise report an unstable ranking. Always withhold a launch/profit optimum because costs, claim substantiation and external validation are absent. Cost scenarios are assumptions, not supplied data.

These constraints are modeling assumptions, not established causal findings.
